name: Saint Felms the Bold

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack that deals moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Teleport Strike
abilities.description: Saint Felms teleports over to you and strikes with his axes, dealing high physical damage. The next attack after teleporting somewhere else will always be Shrapnel Storm.

abilities.name: Shrapnel Storm
abilities.description: Saint Felms summons a storm of pointed metal that whirls around and lingers for a long duration, indicated by a moderately-sized AoE, dealing continuous high physical damage and causes Bleeding.

abilities.name: Manifest Wrath
abilities.description: Saint Felms raises his hand to the sky, causing two volatile projectiles to come slamming down into the arena and sending out shockwaves of dark energy. The initial blasts are indicated by large growing circular AoEs and deal very high physical damage, and the shockwaves don't have indicators and deal high magical damage.

abilities.name: Summon Projections
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, Saint Felms will summon a pair of Pneuma Projections to assist him in battle. They fight much like assassins but their attacks apply bleeding over time, and if left alive for too long, they enrage, drastically increasing their damage output.

related_quests: Saints' Mercy: Neutralize a threat within the Asylum Sanctorium.
summary: Saint Felms the Bold is a contemporary and companion of the Tribunal whose soul was placed into a giant factotum body along with Saint Llothis the Pious and Saint Olms the Just. Unfortunately, the process wasn't a success and the three are under the care of Alienist Llandras in the Asylum Sanctorium.
